Description: Accelerated board hurdle into tight handstand with heel drive, falling straight to flat back on 32" mat stack.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Fast arm swing | Eyes on the board | Lock ribs flat | Pinch heels together
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Run with forward acceleration and hurdle onto the springboard with feet together and arms swinging back to front. 2. Punch the board explosively, punching arms up through ears into a 45° entry toward the mat stack. 3. Hit a vertical handstand momentarily on the front edge of the mat stack with locked elbows and tight ribs. 4. Hollow down and drop flat onto the back with chin tucked, maintaining complete body alignment.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Arching through lower back on impact | Bending elbows on contact | Under-rotating and landing on hips
Prerequisites: Level 2 Handstand fall to flatback (16") | Handstand hold against wall (30 sec)
Video_Title: Handstand Flat Back Vault Technique & Drills

Skill_Name: Run & Hurdle onto Springboard to Straight Jump
Description: Consistent accelerated sprint, low hurdle onto sweet spot of the board, and explosive vertical straight jump with stuck landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Accelerate into board | Low fast hurdle | Punch the springs | Stick and hold 3 seconds
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Sprint 40-50 feet with upright sprinting mechanics and high knees, accelerating progressively. 2. Execute a low, forward-driven hurdle step off one foot without elevating excessively. 3. Punch both balls of feet simultaneously on the sweet spot (front third) of the springboard. 4. Drive arms straight up by ears, soaring into a tight hollow straight jump, and stick the landing on 8" mat.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Decelerating before the hurdle | Jumping too high into the board | Dropping arms on landing
Prerequisites: Springboard bounce drills | Straight jump stick on floor line
Video_Title: How to Run and Hurdle onto the Springboard | Vault Drills

Description: Jump from mat into piked glide swing forward, full body extension with toes pointing at end of swing, and swing back.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Straight arms locked | Pike on way out | Shoot toes forward at full extension | Keep chin neutral
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Stand arm distance behind low bar, jump forward to catch bar with overhand grip. 2. Pike legs smoothly at hips with straight knees, sliding toes just inches off the floor mat. 3. At peak forward swing, open shoulders and extend hips fully into an open hollow body line. 4. Pull heels and hips back toward bar on backswing with straight arms engaged.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Bending knees during glide | Feet scraping the floor | Failing to extend at forward peak
Prerequisites: Hanging hollow hold (15 sec) | Straight leg toe-to-bar raises
Video_Title: How to Master the Glide Swing on Bars | Key Drills

Description: Chin-up pull, dynamic leg kick over low bar, shifting wrists into locked front support.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Chin to bar first | Pull hips into bar | Shift wrists on top | Tall locked chest
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Hang with overgrip, initiate with a strong flexed-arm chin pull bringing chin over bar. 2. Drive knees or straight legs overhead, pulling hips tight against the bar. 3. Rotate hips over the bar while shifting wrists from hang to front support position. 4. Push tall into locked front support with shoulders over bar and legs tight.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Arms straightening during kickover | Hips drifting away from bar | Failing to roll wrists forward
Prerequisites: Flexed arm hang 15s | Candlestick roll to stand
Video_Title: How to Do a Pullover on Bars | Gymnastics Step by Step

Description: From front support, round into hollow, dip shoulders and drive hips upward at least 30°-45° with straight arms.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Press down with palms | Straight elbows locked | Drive with toes | Keep chest hollow
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Begin in locked front support with straight arms and rounded upper back. 2. Bend slightly at the hips to load momentum while keeping arms locked straight. 3. Explosively drive toes and heels backward and upward while pressing downward with hands. 4. Reach a minimum 30° angle with hips clear of the bar before returning softly.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Bent elbows absorbing power | Arching back instead of hollow cast | Hips remaining touching the bar
Prerequisites: Front support hold 20s | Floor cast push-up drills
Video_Title: How to Cast on Uneven Bars | Level 3 & Silver Cast Drills

Description: Cast off bar, fall backward rotating around the bar with hips glued to bar, returning to front support.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Glue hips to the bar | Head neutral (look at toes) | Fast wrist shift on top | Stay stiff like a pencil
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Perform a preliminary cast to clear hips from bar. 2. As body returns, glue thighs/hips to the bar with head neutral and body straight. 3. Drop backward like a statue, using momentum to rotate 360° around the bar. 4. Shift wrists dynamically on top to finish in tall front support.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Throwing head back | Hips peeling away mid-circle | Bending knees
Prerequisites: Solid cast | Front support balance
Video_Title: How to do a Back Hip Circle | Step-by-Step Gymnastics Tutorial

Description: Cast, drop into hollow under the bar, shoot toes upward and outward, releasing bar to a stuck landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Push bar away on cast | Hollow drop | Shoot feet to the ceiling | Spot the landing mat
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Execute a cast to 30°, then drop into an undershoot under the bar keeping hips close. 2. Maintain eye contact with feet as body swings forward under the bar. 3. Shoot toes up toward ceiling and release bar with both hands simultaneously. 4. Land softly in demi-plié with chest upright and stick without stepping.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Releasing too early or late | Piking on landing | Cowboying knees on dismount
Prerequisites: Back hip circle | Glide swing
Video_Title: Undershoot Dismount Tutorial | Level 3 Uneven Bars

Skill_Name: Jump to Front Support Mount on Beam
Description: From springboard or mat, jump with hands on beam to straight-arm front support with tight legs and pointed toes.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Push tall into palms | Knees straight and locked | Eyes focused on far end of beam
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Place hands flat on beam shoulder-width apart, fingers wrapping sides. 2. Punch springboard and push down through palms to elevate hips above beam. 3. Extend shoulders over hands in locked front support with legs glued together. 4. Swing right leg over beam into straddle or squat position with graceful posture.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Shoulders sagging | Banging thighs on beam surface | Loose feet
Prerequisites: Front support hold on floor bar | Beam walk posture
Video_Title: Beam Mounts for Beginners & Silver Level

Skill_Name: Cross Handstand on Beam (Min 45° to Vertical)
Description: Lunge on beam, place hands thumb-to-thumb, kick into tight cross handstand, and step down into balanced lunge.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Reach long in lever | Thumbs touching | Squeeze butt and ribs | Step back into deep lunge
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Start in deep beam lunge with arms by ears and torso aligned with front leg. 2. Reach far out, placing thumbs touching across the beam with fingers wrapped around sides. 3. Kick back leg up while levering body into a vertical or minimum 45° cross handstand. 4. Step down with dominant foot first into a clean beam lunge, arms finished in crown.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Rushing the kickover without levering | Crooked hand placement causing beam slip | Falling off on step-down
Prerequisites: Floor handstand hold 5s | Beam line handstand on floor
Video_Title: How to Do a Handstand on Beam | Safe Drills & Confidence

Description: Lunge on beam, place hand-hand in line, cartwheel in vertical plane, and land foot-foot in balanced lunge.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Keep shoulders in line of beam | Spot hands onto beam | Lock knees at vertical | Step down along center
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Stand in tall lunge on beam, sight the target spot 2 feet in front of toes. 2. Lever down placing lead hand turned inward, follow with second hand directly along center line. 3. Kick back leg strongly over top, passing through a vertical straddle plane with straight legs. 4. Land first foot on center line, immediately followed by second foot in a steady lunge.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Missing center line with second hand | Piking hips out of beam plane | Rushing landing and falling sideways
Prerequisites: Floor beam cartwheel | Floor cartwheel on line
Video_Title: Cartwheel on Beam Tutorial | Step by Step Breakdown

Description: From beam stand, plie and spring straight up, splitting legs equally to 90° separation and landing safely on beam.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Jump UP before splitting | Equal split front and back | Chest stays upright | Absorb landing in plie
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Stand with one foot slightly in front of the other, knees relaxed. 2. Plie through both feet and jump straight upward with arms swinging into side-middle or crown. 3. Split front and back leg simultaneously to at least 90° separation with pointed toes. 4. Pull legs together quickly on descent to land front-foot back-foot with soft knees.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Leaning chest forward | Uneven leg split (front leg high, back leg low) | Landing stiff-legged
Prerequisites: Straight jump on beam | Split jump on floor line
Video_Title: How to Do a Split Jump on Beam | Tips for Balance & Height

Description: Step onto relevé on one foot, rotate 180° smoothly on ball of foot with high posture, and step down.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Stay tall in relevé | Spot the end of beam | Squeeze inner thighs | Core engaged
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Step forward onto the ball of one foot in high relevé, arms in first or fifth position. 2. Spot a focal point at opposite end of the beam to lock balance. 3. Turn head and shoulders 180° while pivoting cleanly on ball of foot. 4. Finish in locked relevé before lowering heel into preparation for next skill.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Dropping heel mid-turn | Wobbling arms out of alignment | Turning off-axis
Prerequisites: Relevé walk on beam | Pivot turns on floor line
Video_Title: Beam Pivot Turns Tutorial | Perfect Balance in Relevé

Skill_Name: Round-off Dismount off End of Beam
Description: Lunge toward end of beam, round-off with 1/4 turn, snap down off beam onto 8" landing mat and stick.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Drive the hurdle along center line | Push beam away with hands | Snap feet down together | Stick landing firmly
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Lunge along beam line approaching the dismount end with confident momentum. 2. Place hands in line near the end of the beam, kicking legs over with aggressive snap. 3. Push off beam with hands, snapping legs together before passing end of beam. 4. Land facing beam on landing mat, absorbing impact in demi-plié with arms presented.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Looking down at hands and under-rotating | Releasing hands prematurely | Landing too close to beam
Prerequisites: Floor round-off with rebound | Cartwheel dismount off beam
Video_Title: How to Do a Round Off Dismount on Beam

Description: Hurdle into powerful 1/2 turn round-off with strong hand repulsion, snapping down to high vertical rebound.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Fast low hurdle | T-hand placement | Snap down to hollow | Explosive vertical rebound
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Take a 3-step run into a long, low hurdle with chest upright. 2. Reach hands down in a T-shape line, kicking back leg overhead into 1/2 twist. 3. Block aggressively through shoulders, snapping feet together through hollow body. 4. Rebound straight up out of punch with arms by ears, sticking clean on landing.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Bent elbows on hand contact | Slow snap down | Landing with chest dropped forward
Prerequisites: Level 1 Cartwheel | Handstand snap-down on mat
Video_Title: Round-Off Rebound Technique & Common Mistakes

Description: Controlled vertical handstand, soft step down into bridge, followed by immediate split kickover to lunge.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Hold handstand 1 count before bridge | Push shoulders over wrists in bridge | Kick with straight knee | Stand tall into lunge
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Lunge forward into a vertical handstand with shoulders open and toes pointed. 2. Lower lead foot softly to mat into bridge while pushing shoulders open over hands. 3. Without pausing, push off floor through supporting foot and drive lead leg overhead in split. 4. Pass through handstand back to a tall finish lunge.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Crashing onto feet in bridge | Stuck in bridge unable to kickover | Bending supporting leg
Prerequisites: Bridge kickover from mat | Solid handstand hold
Video_Title: How to Do a Handstand to Bridge Kickover Tutorial

Skill_Name: Back Extension Roll to Push-up / Handstand
Description: Straight arm backward roll with fast hip extension, pushing up through handstand or push-up hollow.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Fast hands by ears | Drive toes to the ceiling | Push hard through palms | Stay hollow in core
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Stand tall, roll back with straight legs and hands positioned next to ears palms-up. 2. As hips pass over head, push explosively through palms while extending hips fully. 3. Lock arms and legs straight, passing through a high push-up or handstand angle. 4. Step down into balanced finish with chest high.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Bending knees during roll | Slow hand push causing head strain | Piking on push-up finish
Prerequisites: Level 1 Backward roll | Push-up hold 30s
Video_Title: Back Extension Roll Tutorial | Clean Form & Drills

Description: Step-chassé into grand jeté split leap with minimum 90° split angle, straight knees, and pointed toes.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Brush foot along floor | Split at apex of jump | Keep chest over hips | Quiet toe-ball-heel landing
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Take a continuous step or chassé with upright carriage and pointed feet. 2. Brush lead foot forward through low battement, exploding off trailing leg. 3. Achieve minimum 90° leg split at the peak of elevation with chest held tall. 4. Land softly in plie on front foot and step out with elegance.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Bent back knee | Dropping chest forward | Insufficient split under 90°
Prerequisites: Floor split stretches | Split leaps over mat
Video_Title: How to Get Better Split Leaps | Drills for 180 and Height

Description: Preparation step into high relevé, complete 360° turn on single support leg with heel high off floor.
Key_Coaching_Cues: High relevé on big toe | Snap head around in spot | Squeeze glutes | Hold finish 1 second
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Step forward into preparation plie, arms curved in first position. 2. Rise sharply onto high relevé on supporting foot, drawing free foot into passé at ankle or knee. 3. Spot a fixed target on wall, whip head around 360° to lock landing spot. 4. Finish with control on relevé before lowering heel gracefully.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Dropping heel mid-rotation | Losing spot causing over/under-rotation | Wobbling on step-out
Prerequisites: 1/2 turn on relevé | Passé balance on floor (10 sec)
Video_Title: How to Do a Full Turn in Gymnastics & Dance | Form & Spotting

Description: Full run, punch springboard, pre-flight onto vault table, shoulder repulsion into post-flight, and stuck feet landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Full sprint acceleration | Fast shoulder block off table | Stay completely hollow | Stick landing firmly
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Sprint with maximum velocity down the 60-foot runway without stuttering. 2. Hurdle onto the springboard with arms driving backward to forward. 3. Hit board and punch into a straight pre-flight body angle of ~40° to the table. 4. Block explosively through shoulders on contact with the table and fly into stuck landing.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Piking or arching on the table | Bending elbows during contact | Squatting on landing
Prerequisites: Silver Handstand flatback | Front handspring on floor
Video_Title: How to Do a Front Handspring Vault | Technique Breakdown

Skill_Name: Half-On Vault Entry Drill (1/4 - 1/2 Twist Entry)
Description: Board punch with 1/4 to 1/2 twist onto vault table or mat stack, setting foundation for Tsukahara & Yurchenko family.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Twist from the core, not arms | Eyes spot hands on table | Explosive shoulder block | Tight hollow alignment
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Hurdle onto springboard with rapid arm drive. 2. Punch board and initiate 1/4 to 1/2 turn from hips and core during pre-flight. 3. Place hands staggered/turned on table to repel off in sideways-to-backward alignment. 4. Land on feet or back onto mat stack with body rigid.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Twisting too early before leaving board | Collapsing support arm | Over-rotating off side of mat
Prerequisites: Front handspring vault | Round-off onto mat stack
Video_Title: Tsukahara & Half-On Vault Drills for Level 5 and Gold

Description: Full extension glide swing forward, toes-to-bar pull on backswing, shift wrists and shoot into front support.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Big open glide at the front | Toes to bar fast on return | Shins slide the bar | Wrist shift on top!
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Jump from mat into a long, powerful glide swing with legs straight and toes off floor. 2. Extend fully at forward peak, opening chest and hips into hollow body. 3. On backswing, pull toes rapidly to the bar while keeping arms straight. 4. Slide shins up the bar, shift wrists aggressively over bar and press tall into front support.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Piking on forward glide | Bending elbows when pulling toes up | Failing to roll wrists forward
Prerequisites: Silver glide swing | Toe-to-bar leg lifts (10 reps) | Front support press
Video_Title: How to Do a Kip on Uneven Bars | The Ultimate Coaching Guide

Description: From front support, dip shoulders slightly and cast explosively to horizontal or higher with straight arms and locked body.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Push down hard through palms | Straight elbows never bend | Drive heels above horizontal | Keep core locked
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Start in high front support with straight arms and rounded hollow upper body. 2. Load with a slight hip drop without bending elbows. 3. Press downward with palms while driving heels and toes upward past horizontal. 4. Hit horizontal line with toes pointed and return smoothly to bar.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Casting below horizontal | Arched back casting | Bent arms
Prerequisites: Silver cast to 30° | Plank push-ups (15 reps)
Video_Title: How to Cast to Horizontal and Handstand | Bars Drills

Skill_Name: Clear Hip Circle to Horizontal (Back Free Hip)
Description: Cast, drop backward maintaining gap between hips and bar, rotate around bar and shoot clear of bar to horizontal.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Push bar away on drop | Keep arms locked straight | Open shoulders on the rise | Look at toes then spot bar
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Cast to horizontal, drop backward keeping straight arms pushing bar down. 2. Do not let hips rest on the bar; maintain hollow curve 2-4 inches off bar. 3. Rotate under bar and pull bar into hips momentarily, then push bar away. 4. Shoot open to horizontal or above on rise with arms locked straight.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Resting hips on bar (turning it into a back hip circle) | Bent arms | Dropping head back
Prerequisites: Cast to horizontal | Back hip circle mastery
Video_Title: Clear Hip Circle on Uneven Bars | Level 4/5 Technique Drills

Skill_Name: Squat-on / Pike-on to High Bar Jump
Description: Cast from low bar, place feet between hands on low bar in squat or pike, stand and jump to catch high bar.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Lift hips high on cast | Light feet on the bar | Spot high bar with eyes | Catch high bar with straight arms
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Cast from low bar, lift hips high above bar level with straight arms. 2. Place balls of feet softly on the low bar between or outside hands. 3. Stand up with chest rising and eyes spotting the high bar overhead. 4. Jump forward and upward to catch high bar in solid overgrip with straight arms.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Feet slipping off low bar | Jumping before standing balanced | Bent arm catch on high bar
Prerequisites: Cast to horizontal | Floor squat-on drills
Video_Title: Squat On and Jump to High Bar Tutorial | Uneven Bars

Skill_Name: Tuck Flyaway Dismount from High Bar
Description: Tap swing on high bar, drive toes upward on front swing, release bar into tucked backward somersault and stick landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Kick toes to the ceiling | Release on the rise | Tuck tight around shins | Spot mat and open to stick
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Execute dynamic tap swings on high bar, creating high hollow-to-arch momentum. 2. On front swing, drive toes upward past horizontal toward ceiling. 3. Release the bar at 45° angle, pull knees tightly to chest in tucked somersault. 4. Spot landing mat, open tuck and stick firmly with arms in salute.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Releasing too early (flying backward low) | Releasing too late (flying straight up into bar) | Loose tuck
Prerequisites: Tap swings on high bar | Back tuck on trampoline / floor
Video_Title: How to Do a Flyaway on Bars | Progressive Drills & Safety

Description: Lift lead leg, arch backward placing hands in line on beam, kick through 180° split and land in balanced lunge.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Lift leg before arching | Keep arms glued to ears | Hands thumb-to-thumb | Hold finish lunge solid
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Stand tall on beam with lead leg extended front and arms by ears. 2. Lift lead leg while arching backward through upper spine, eyes watching hands. 3. Place hands thumb-to-thumb on center line of beam with open shoulders. 4. Kick back foot up and through a full 180° split, stepping down softly in lunge.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Dropping hands off center line | Insufficient leg split under 120° | Wobbling on landing step-out
Prerequisites: Floor back walkover on line | Beam back walkover on low beam
Video_Title: How to Do a Back Walkover on Beam | Balance & Alignment

Skill_Name: Back Handspring Step-out on Beam (Acro Prep)
Description: Sit in beam chair, jump backward with flight onto hands, step-out one foot at a time into confident lunge.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Sit back before jumping | Look for beam between hands | Snap lead foot down on line | Stand tall into lunge
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Stand on beam with feet aligned, sit back as if into a chair with arms swinging. 2. Jump backward aggressively, extending through hips and driving arms by ears. 3. Place hands in line on beam, blocking through shoulders while splitting legs. 4. Step lead foot down along center line followed by back foot into secure lunge.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Jumping crooked off center | Short undercutting jump causing head crash | Bent arms on hand impact
Prerequisites: Floor back handspring step-out on line | Low beam back handspring with mats
Video_Title: Back Handspring on Balance Beam Tutorial | Fear-Free Drills

Description: Running step or chassé into forward grand jeté on beam with minimum 120° split separation, sticking landing on line.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Brush foot along beam | Split evenly at apex | Chest tall and proud | Land softly on center line
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Step smoothly along beam with upright core and confident vision. 2. Brush front foot forward aggressively while pushing through back ball of foot. 3. Reach a minimum 120° split at peak height with torso vertical. 4. Land on front foot in demi-plié along center line with trailing leg controlled.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Leaning forward on take-off | Split less than 120° | Landing off center line of beam
Prerequisites: Silver split leap | Floor 180° splits
Video_Title: Mastering Split Leaps on Beam | Height, Split & Consistency

Skill_Name: Full 1/1 Turn on One Foot on Beam
Description: Single foot relevé turn completing 360° on beam with free leg in passé, finishing locked on beam line.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Highest relevé possible | Spot the end of beam | Hold core hollow and tight | Freeze finish on line
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Step forward onto supporting foot in deep plie, setting arms in first position. 2. Press into high relevé on ball of foot, snapping free foot into coupé or passé. 3. Spot far end of beam, whip head 360° and lock gaze back onto the beam. 4. Stop turn precisely on line with high relevé before lowering heel.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Dropping heel during turn | Incomplete rotation (under 360°) | Wobbling off side of beam on stop
Prerequisites: 1/2 turn on beam | Full turn on floor beam
Video_Title: Full Turn on Beam Tutorial | How to Stick Every Time

Description: Hurdle or step punch off end of beam into forward tucked somersault, opening to stick on landing mat.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Punch off toes at end of beam | Jump UP before tucking | Grab shins tight | Spot mat and stick
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Approach end of beam with confident step-hurdle punch off balls of feet. 2. Drive arms and hips upward into a high forward somersault takeoff. 3. Tuck knees tightly to chest with hands grabbing shins. 4. Spot landing mat, open out of tuck and stick firmly in demi-plié.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Diving forward instead of upward | Slow opening causing deep squat or fall | Stumbling forward on landing
Prerequisites: Front tuck on floor / trampoline | Round-off dismount off beam
Video_Title: How to Do a Front Tuck Dismount off Beam | Safe Progressions

Description: Speed approach into round-off, connected back handspring, rebound punch into high backward tucked salto with stuck landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Fast handspring into punch | Drive chest UP on takeoff | Tuck tight around shins | Spot floor and stick landing
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Run with acceleration into a powerful round-off with aggressive snap down. 2. Immediately rebound into a fast, long back handspring, keeping arms by ears. 3. Punch both feet off floor through toes, driving chest and arms straight up into the air. 4. Pull knees to chest in a tight tuck, rotate 360°, open body and stick the landing.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Throwing head back on takeoff | Slow back handspring robbing height | Under-rotating into hands-down landing
Prerequisites: Solid back handspring series | Standing back tuck on mat
Video_Title: Round-Off Back Handspring Back Tuck Gymnastics Tutorial

Description: Short run into two-foot punch, soaring into high forward tucked somersault and landing upright with control.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Punch hard off toes | Lift hips over shoulders | Tuck tight | Kick out before landing
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Run 3-4 steps with forward acceleration into a low, fast hurdle. 2. Punch both balls of feet simultaneously with arms lifting from hips past ears. 3. Lift hips high over head while tucking knees firmly into chest. 4. Spot floor on rotation, kick out of tuck and absorb landing with chest high.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Diving forward with low hips | Cowboying knees wide | Landing in low squat
Prerequisites: Front handspring step-out | Trampoline punch front
Video_Title: How to Do a Punch Front (Front Tuck) | Floor Gymnastics

Description: Swing lead leg forward to 45°, quickly scissor-switch legs in mid-air to reach minimum 120°-180° grand jeté split.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Quick leg scissor in air | Chest stays upright and tall | Point both toes through switch | Land softly on front foot
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Take a step-chassé preparation with upright posture. 2. Swing lead leg forward to approximately 45° with straight knee and pointed toe. 3. Aggressively switch legs in mid-air, driving front leg back and back leg forward. 4. Hit peak split of 120°+ before landing softly in demi-plié on front foot.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Swinging lead leg too high before switch | Dropping chest forward during split | Bent back leg on finish
Prerequisites: Silver split leap | Floor switch leap drills
Video_Title: Switch Leap Tutorial | How to Get a 180 Degree Switch Leap

Skill_Name: Front Handspring Half-Off Vault (1/2 Twist Off)
Description: Front handspring repulsion off vault table with 180° twist during post-flight, landing facing the vault table.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Block first, then twist | Keep arms close to body on twist | Spot vault table on landing | Stick with locked knees
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Execute maximum speed run and punch springboard into strong pre-flight. 2. Block aggressively off table through shoulders in straight body alignment. 3. Initiate 1/2 twist from hips and core during post-flight after clearing table. 4. Spot the vault table and stick landing facing back toward the apparatus.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Twisting on the table before blocking | Piking hips during twist | Under-rotating into backwards step
Prerequisites: Gold front handspring vault | Trampoline front handspring 1/2 twist
Video_Title: Front Handspring Half Off Vault Breakdown & Post-Flight Drills

Skill_Name: Tsukahara Vault Entry Drill (1/4 - 1/2 Turn On)
Description: Punch board, 1/4 to 1/2 turn cartwheel entry onto vault table, repelling backwards into high post-flight landing on feet.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Fast board entry | Square shoulders to table on contact | Violent repulsion block | Tight hollow backward flight
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. High-velocity run into aggressive springboard punch with arms driving up. 2. Turn 1/4 to 1/2 onto the table, placing first and second hand in cartwheel/round-off line. 3. Repel violently off the table through shoulders while snapping body straight. 4. Soar backward through air into solid upright landing on resi-mat.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Turning too late off the board | Collapsing shoulder on hand contact | Piking on post-flight
Prerequisites: Gold front handspring vault | Round-off onto vault table drills
Video_Title: Tsukahara Vault Drills & Progressions | Platinum Gymnastics

Description: From front support, cast with straight arms directly into a vertical handstand (within 10° of vertical) with ribs tucked.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Push bar down aggressively | Open shoulders all the way | Heels drive straight to ceiling | Lock ribs flat
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Start in high front support with straight arms and rounded upper back. 2. Lower slightly into hollow load and press down vigorously through palms. 3. Drive heels upward and open shoulders over hands into vertical handstand line. 4. Lock ribs, squeeze glutes, and hold vertical momentarily before returning or circling.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Bent arms | Arching back (banana back) over vertical | Casting short below 45°
Prerequisites: Gold cast to horizontal | Floor handstand push-ups | Bar pirouette drills
Video_Title: How to Cast to Handstand on Uneven Bars | Pro Drills

Skill_Name: Giant Circle (Back Giant on High Bar)
Description: Full 360° rotation around high bar with straight arms and extended body line, passing through handstand.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Stay long and straight on drop | Tap through the bottom | Shift wrists on top | Hit handstand line at peak
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Cast to handstand on high bar, fall forward in long straight-body extension. 2. Pass under bar maintaining straight arms and tap heels through bottom. 3. On upswing, hollow chest and shift wrists over top of bar. 4. Kick heels through vertical handstand at apex and continue or prepare dismount.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Bending arms at the bottom | Piking too early on upswing | Failing to shift wrists resulting in peel-off
Prerequisites: Cast to handstand | Strap bar giant swings | Clear hip circle

Skill_Name: Layout Flyaway Dismount from High Bar
Description: High tap swing on high bar, release into straight-body backward layout salto with zero knee bend and stick landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Strong heel drive on front swing | Release at 45° angle | Keep body locked like a board | Spot mat to stick
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Build momentum with high tap swing from giant circle or long hang cast. 2. At bottom of front swing, execute a sharp hollow tap driving heels upward. 3. Release bar as toes reach 45° above horizontal, holding body completely straight. 4. Spot the mat, absorb landing in solid stuck position with arms raised.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Piking or tucking knees (downgrade to tuck flyaway) | Releasing too early or late | Arching over on landing
Prerequisites: Gold tuck flyaway | Trampoline back layout

Skill_Name: Back Handspring Step-out on Beam (Flight Acro)
Description: Sit back into beam flight jump backward, hands contacting center line with shoulder block, stepping out into confident lunge.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Sit back before leaping | Spot hands onto beam line | Aggressive shoulder block | Hold finish lunge motionless
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Stand in tall aligned posture on beam, sit hips back in controlled hinge. 2. Drive through legs into backwards jump with arms sweeping past ears. 3. Block through palms on beam line while opening legs in split step-out. 4. Land first foot on center line, followed immediately by second foot in a locked lunge.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Jumping crooked off beam | Bending elbows on hand contact | Flipping head back and missing line
Prerequisites: Gold back handspring prep | Floor back handspring on straight line
Video_Title: Back Handspring Step-Out on Beam | Fear Breakdown & Drills

Description: Forward lunge on beam, aggressive heel kick into no-handed cartwheel over beam, landing foot-foot in balanced lunge.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Deep lunge drive | Violent back leg kick | Keep chest aligned with beam | Spot the beam for landing
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Take a confident step into deep lunge on beam with chest driving forward. 2. Drive lead leg down into beam while kicking back leg with maximum velocity overhead. 3. Keep chest up and arms pulled into body or crown, rotating without hand support. 4. Spot beam center line on landing, stepping lead foot down followed by back foot.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Diving hands down toward beam in panic | Piking hips sideways | Landing crooked off center line
Prerequisites: Floor aerial cartwheel | Low beam aerial cartwheel with mats
Video_Title: Aerial Cartwheel on Balance Beam Tutorial | Drills & Confidence

Description: Round-off or punch off end of beam, soaring into straight-body back layout salto, sticking on landing mat.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Explosive rebound off beam end | Straight body alignment (no tuck or pike) | Spot the mat and stick
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Hurdle into round-off off end of beam, blocking through hands on the wood. 2. Rebound backwards and upward with body held straight as an arrow. 3. Rotate through 360° layout somersault with arms by ears or crossed on chest. 4. Spot the landing mat, open chest and stick firmly in demi-plié.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Piking or tucking knees mid-air | Under-rotating into back step | Rebounding crooked off beam
Prerequisites: Gold front tuck dismount | Round-off back layout on floor
Video_Title: Back Layout Beam Dismount Tutorial | Level 7 & Platinum

Description: Round-off back handspring into maximum height punch, soaring through completely straight backward somersault to stick.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Fast round-off BHS transition | Punch straight UP | Hold body straight like a pencil | Spot floor and stick
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Accelerate through a long hurdle into powerful round-off and back handspring. 2. Punch both balls of feet, driving arms straight overhead into high backward trajectory. 3. Maintain rigid hollow body line throughout entire 360° backward rotation. 4. Spot the floor, extend through ankles and stick landing cleanly with no steps.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Bending knees (turning it into a back tuck) | Piking at hips (piked layout) | Throwing head backward prematurely
Prerequisites: Gold back tuck on floor | Trampoline layout somersault
Video_Title: How to Do a Back Layout on Floor | Gymnastics Tutorial

Description: Punch into back layout salto, initiating a 180° twist at the peak of the jump, and landing facing backwards.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Flip first, then twist | Tight wrap across chest | Look over shoulder for spot | Land facing opposite direction
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Execute powerful round-off back handspring into vertical punch. 2. Rise into layout position with arms overhead. 3. At apex of salto, wrap arms into chest and initiate 1/2 twist from hips. 4. Spot landing facing backwards, absorb impact in demi-plié and stick.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Twisting off the floor before lifting | Piking hips during twist | Under-twisting landing sideways
Prerequisites: Back layout salto | Front layout salto
Video_Title: Back Layout Half Twist Tutorial | Floor Gymnastics

Description: High forward punch into straight-body front salto, rotating 360° forward without knee bend, sticking landing.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Lift hips high over head | Keep legs glued together | Lock body straight | Stick landing with chest high
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Sprint forward into low, aggressive hurdle punch on balls of feet. 2. Drive arms and chest upward into high forward trajectory. 3. Maintain hollow body straight alignment as hips rotate forward over shoulders. 4. Spot floor on final descent, open body and stick landing softly.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Piking at hips | Diving forward low to mat | Over-rotating and taking forward step
Prerequisites: Gold punch front tuck | Front pike salto
Video_Title: Front Layout Salto Tutorial | Floor Gymnastics

Skill_Name: Switch Leap to Tour Jeté Connection (Dance Series)
Description: Switch leap (180° split) connected seamlessly without extra steps into a 1/2-turning tour jeté split leap.
Key_Coaching_Cues: Seamless rhythm between leaps | 180° split on both elements | Spot each landing | Maintain high artistic presentation
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Perform switch leap with full 180° leg split and upright chest. 2. Land on ball of front foot in plie and immediately step into tour jeté preparation. 3. Jump and turn 180° in mid-air while switching legs into reverse grand jeté. 4. Land softly in arabesque or fondue with expressive posture.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Stutter step between leaps | Insufficient split angle under 180° | Losing balance on landing
Prerequisites: Gold switch leap | Tour jeté leap
Video_Title: Switch Leap & Tour Jeté Dance Connections | Gymnastics Artistry

Skill_Name: Double Turn (720° on One Foot on Floor)
Description: Two full rotations (720°) on the ball of a single foot in high relevé with free leg in passé, finishing with control.
Key_Coaching_Cues: High relevé on big toe | Fast double spot with head | Squeeze core and inner thighs | Clean finish on relevé
Step_by_Step_Execution: 1. Step forward into preparation lunge, arms centered in first position. 2. Push sharply into high relevé on single support leg, snapping free leg to knee passé. 3. Whip head around twice in rapid spotting action to complete 720° rotation. 4. Lock hips and core, checking out cleanly on relevé before lowering heel.
Common_Faults_To_Avoid: Dropping heel after first turn | Failing to spot causing dizziness/drifting | Under-rotating into uncontrolled fall
Prerequisites: Gold full turn (360°) | Passé balance on high relevé
